detail.diskUsageDesc: Disk mainly usage shows where the trash files separate and the risk level to be delete
detail.levelADesc: A: Items confirmed to be safe to delete and regenerate, such as explicit cache directories, Temp, CrashDumps, DXCache, and useless log or thumbnail cache directories.
detail.levelBDesc: B: Recommended to move or left to the user's discretion, such as large model caches, old backups, video footage, compressed files, and exported project files.
detail.levelCDesc: C: Risk exists; AI cannot fully confirm its intended use.

autoContextCompress.label: Smart Context Compression(BETA)
autoContextCompress.warning: Enabling this feature will automatically compress the context once it reaches a certain size. It's generally not recommended to enable this feature; it should only be done when the token budget is limited or the context becomes full due to the model itself.

llmExtraBody.label: LLM Extra Body
llmExtraBody.description: An optional JSON object will be incorporated into the body of each LLM request. If you are using deepseek-v4 or another model that has think mode enabled by default, please disable it via a parameter, as think mode will severely slow down the analysis.
